title: a write through a symlinked folder, a symlinked file or a dangling symlink into a protected place is denied
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A5 (defect N-25): the guard denies writes into builds, jitso/jitso.yaml and the hard rules
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-25, owner answer A5). A Write follows symlinks, so the guard resolves the path (the deepest existing ancestor, and a link at the end even when its target does not exist yet) before it judges it. A link that leads into jitso/builds/ or the hard rules cannot be used to write there.

reason.regex: ^JITSO: only the owner changes approved builds, jitso/jitso\.yaml and the hard rules; draft a build with (bun run jitso|jitso) build draft and ask the owner to save it \(denied: [A-Za-z -]+ jitso/(builds/|hard-rules/|jitso\.yaml)?\)$
